recorded_storage_replay.meaning: Same recorded model output through actual SQLite storage, no seeded graph nodes; this isolates the storage correction rather than model quality.

occurrences.name: Envoi de la notification écrite par Rivage Travaux SARL
Suspension des travaux par Lys Patrimoine SAS

remaining_omissions: No performer links were stored for either occurrence
Notice performer recovered only as a separately reviewed candidate
fresh_full_stack.interpretation: A fresh generation used a different notice title and the pre-existing actor-word preservation branch. The deterministic replay, not this unpaired generation, demonstrates the new profile-word branch.

limits: Only future qualifying extractions are affected; existing graph nodes are not migrated
Retention is a lexical/profile/source-date safeguard, not independent semantic verification
Unmeasured event categories, domains, languages and layouts remain unverified
No stored performer link was repaired by recheck or prompt import
No new Laya training, GLiNER comparison or acceleration benchmark
